description: Open one workflow as a PLAN bound to the task: the ordered tool calls with the act number, case number or date from `task` filled in and every other slot left open, the principles and what the result looks like - under 2,000 characters. You run the steps yourself, in order. `detail='full'` adds the prose.

detail.description: `plan` (the default): the ordered calls, principles and outputs, under 2,000 characters. `full` adds the prose body the plan was copied from.
detail.title: Detail

session.description: The `session` value the sign-in returned. Pass it on every call in this conversation, so the sign-in survives however this client handles connections; omit it when the user connected with Sign in (OAuth) or a key.

task.description: The user's task in a sentence. Exact identifiers in it (an act number `XII-2603`, a case number `e3K-3-105-684/2019`, a date `2021-03-01`) are filled into the plan's slots; every other slot stays open for you to fill.
task.title: Task

workflow_id.description: Which workflow to open, by the `workflow_id` from `find_workflow` or `list_workflows` - e.g. `still-good-law`, `job-matter-memo`. A bare id is the playbook; a job is `job-<id>`.
workflow_id.title: Workflow Id

name: get_workflow
title: Open a playbook or job
